notes.title: /Conspiracy/ Girls Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
*tingting* Ahem, I have an announcement to make!

The long awaited sequel to Conspiracy Girls, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132900/Conspiracy_Girls_The_Madness_of_Madison_Delaroux/][u][b]/Conspiracy/ Girls >The Madness of Madison Delaroux[/b][/u][/url] is now on Steam!

[h2]/Conspiracy/ Girls is the story of cute and funny girls who go around exposing conspiracies, and getting into all sorts of trouble for doing so![/h2]

A year and a half has passed in our world. I know I said that Conspiracy Girls was a one of a kind thing that would never be replicated, but here we are! A year and a half later, I am very proud of the sequel to the OG Conspiracy Girls. My technique is greatly improved, everyone is far cuter and funnier, and the memes are also far more EXQUISITE.

It was a year and a half of work; looking back at the ((Secret Livestream)) I really did fulfill my promise of writing something like six episodes of anime!

If you enjoyed this OG pilot episode of Conspiracy Girls, why not delve deeper into the conspiracy iceberg? The only visual novel that puts a sock on those who would make you eat ze bugs, [u][b]/Conspiracy/ Girls![/b][/u]

Now available for the meme price of $17.76!

Do it!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2132900/Conspiracy_Girls_The_Madness_of_Madison_Delaroux/]Buy /Conspiracy/ Girls today![/url]

You will own everything and be happy!

Arthur Delaroux
HouseDelaroux.com

notes.title: Thanks to all for reading!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Delaroux,

It's been a few days since [i]Conspiracy Girls[/i] released, did you all rike it?

First of all special thanks to, [i]AllGamesWorldHd[/i], [i]Heuster 101[/i], [i]Sokol Free Channel[/i], [i]Pink Alpaca Plays[/i], [i]OldSpookGaming[/i] for featuring the game on their channels!

Especially to [i]NateJames Plays on crappy Old Computer[/i] who made an unexpected read-through of the entire thing~

It's been a long journey and I think I deserve a well-earnt vacation...

[u][b]
Not, lol.[/b][/u]

The past couple of weeks I've been watching some [i]Terrible Writing Advice[/i] on how to write a better story, and reading some preddy good VNs to make my next work better. I have some thoughts on what makes a good story myself, there will be actual gameplay by the fall.

I've always been working on an actual arc of [i]Conspiracy Girls[/i] where an actual conspiracy is exposed. It's been worked on even before fat Gabe started pestering me for all my tax details. [u][b]I hope to sell it on Steam when I get a chance.[/b][/u]

HOWEVER.

I took a small detour in experimental writing, having been brainwashed into writing about love triangles and what-not, and I kind of liked the results.

In the small cracks of time, [u][b]I am working on a story called "[i]The Sunset and the Sorceress[/i]", it's a love story between a sorcerer and a sorceress who have to fight against an entire continent trying to tear them apart. [/b][/u]Told through the narration of a magic meido. 

The story is set in Bylon a month after the main events of Conspiracy Girls ends. (yes, I already know the ending, no, there will be no Arminvengers ending)

[u][b]
Maybe you'll rike it, maybe not, the future is always uncertain, but I'll keep writing forward. [/b][/u]The fastest way to pester me and yell "WRITE YOUR BOOK" while I am playing Warh####r is to just add me on Steam? The [url=https://discord.com/invite/MZQ8xSnEGP]Discord[/url] is still up too!

Thanks again for the views and lieks, it means a lot to me~
